Name: Make Krobus Gaster
Author: DiStri
Description:
A friend asked for a Gaster sprite for Krobus since they're both goofy and she [i]loves[/i] Gaster.

[b]How to Install:

[/b]Extract the contents of the .zip folder and move the Krobus.xnb file to Stardew Valley/Contents/Characters. Likewise for the portrait, only it goes in the Portraits folder. Don't forget to back up your original Krobus.xnb files just in case!

Downloads.Description: Contains both the sprites and portraits

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
